messages:
maya: kicking off RC for sculpt-service v2.7.0-rc1 — origination in the 14:00 change window. artifact: s3://ci/artifacts/sculpt/2.7.0-rc1.tar.gz. requesting QA eyeballs and kv-warm plan. @sam @liam :eyes:

deploy-bot: build 98765 ✅ smoke passed, signatures ok, checksum: sha256:abc123... Artifact pinned to candidate tag v2.7.0-rc1. CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/builds/98765

sam: grabbing a quick regression run now. will run happy-path + embeddings subset. ETA ~8m.

liam: ran quick smoke on staging (canary 5%). saw 3 p95/p99 spikes during kv-warm on node-a-03 between 14:02-14:04. snippet:
```
14:02:12 sculpt.embedding p99=420ms
14:02:35 sculpt.embedding p99=510ms
14:03:01 sculpt.generate p99=380ms
```
not blocking but flagging.

olivia: release notes draft pasted below — feel free to trim:
- sculpt-service: v2.7.0-rc1 (adds KV prefix caching, improved batching heuristics)
- Fix: reduced cold-start jitter for small sequences
- Known issue: 2-3 intermittent p99 spikes during initial KV warm on some instances

maya: plan: pin feature-flag db-migrations=off for rollout, route 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% over 20m. rollback plan: revert route to stable-v2 and re-pin artifact 98764; run db rollback script if needed. runbook: /runbooks/release/rollback-sculpt.md. @liam are you taking sheriff for this window?

sheriff-bot: sheriff assigned -> liam for 14:00-15:00 UTC. deadman timer set: 30m. reminders enabled. :bell:

sam: QA complete for critical flows (gen, embed, rerank). small perf regression on embeddings p99 +2% which is within acceptance threshold. no functional blockers.

maya: scheduling promote in 10m. deploy-bot, start the staged promotion when ready. :rocket:

deploy-bot: promotion initiated by maya. steps:
1) tag artifact 98765 -> v2.7.0-rc1
2) set routing to 10% canary for 5m
3) run smoke-eval job (job id 7744)
4) ramp 50% for 10m, then 100%
commands (ops):
```bash
ci promote --build 98765 --tag v2.7.0-rc1 --route canary:10 --smoke-id 7744
```

deploy-bot: smoke-eval job 7744 started. linking logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/7744/logs

olivia: docs + changelog updated: https://docs.redwood/sculpt/2.7.0-rc1/release-notes 

liam: observability check during 10% canary: kv cache warms as expected, transient spikes resolved after warm. no increase in errors, CPU and GPU utilization normal. ready to continue ramp.

deploy-bot: ramping to 50% -> scheduled hold 10m -> then final ramp.

deploy-bot: promotion complete — traffic at 100%. monitored window: 20m, uptime within window 99.99%, error rate unchanged. pinned artifact v2.7.0-rc1 to prod. If rollback is required run: `deploy rollback 98764` or trigger `/sheriff rollback now`.

maya: closing thread — RC created, promoted, and pinned. small perf note captured in release notes. please notify support and sales with the changelog link. :shipit:
